def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    if k == 0:
        return [0] * n

    rank = {value: i + 1 for i, value in enumerate(sorted(set(a)))}
    size = len(rank)
    bit = [0] * (size + 1)
    result = [0] * n

    for i, value in enumerate(a):
        r = rank[value]

        count_le = 0
        j = r
        while j > 0:
            count_le += bit[j]
            j -= j & -j

        result[i] = min(i, k) - count_le

        j = r
        while j <= size:
            bit[j] += 1
            j += j & -j

        if i >= k:
            j = rank[a[i - k]]
            while j <= size:
                bit[j] -= 1
                j += j & -j

    return result
